proposal.description: The shift subtracts one strike to make up for strike_counter incrementing on entry, so a cool-down at strike level L lasts base_clks<<(L-1): the first hiccup gets the base interval and every later one gets half its intended length
proposal.reason: In every hiccup, once strike_level has stepped up on entry (level 1 or 2), hiccup_done is raised after half the intended number of clocks. So the supervisor goes back to S_SS early, and on the first strike it waits only base_clks instead of 2*base_clks.

proposal.description: Outside S_HICCUP the counter is parked at the live target instead of being cleared to zero (a misreading of 'held at target rather than reset'), so every cool-down starts already finished
proposal.reason: On any entry to S_HICCUP after reset, the counter already equals the target on the first active clock (strike_level has not yet stepped up), so hiccup_done rises one clock after hiccup_active instead of after base_clks<<level clocks. The cool-down is skipped completely.

proposal.description: hiccup_done is made a one-clock pulse: on reaching the target the counter re-arms to zero and the counting branch clears the flag, so done is not held until the supervisor leaves S_HICCUP
proposal.reason: When the interval elapses, hiccup_done drops on the very next clock while hiccup_active is still high. In the original it stays high until the clock after hiccup_active falls, so the done output is one clock shorter and low inside S_HICCUP.
